body_md:
Important Christian festivals are **Christmas** (25 December) and **Easter**. Boxing Day is 26 December. Other faiths' festivals, such as Diwali, Eid al-Fitr, Hanukkah and Vaisakhi, are celebrated too.

Other traditions include New Year (Hogmanay in Scotland), Valentine's Day (14 February), April Fool's Day (1 April, jokes until midday), Halloween (31 October) and Bonfire Night (5 November).

On **Remembrance Day**, 11 November, people wear poppies to remember those who died in wars.
